package usage // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/usage/usage"

Package usage is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package usage is a small Loom rebuild of the compact Harnez usage watch.

FUNCTIONS

func NewWidget(args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidget parses the standalone command's options and builds its root
    widget.

func NewWidgetFromOptions(opts Options) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidgetFromOptions creates a hostable widget with an injectable source.

func Run(args []string) error

TYPES

type DataSource interface {
	Collect(context.Context, time.Time) (Snapshot, error)
}
    DataSource collects one coherent example snapshot.

type DataSourceFunc func(context.Context, time.Time) (Snapshot, error)
    DataSourceFunc adapts a function into a DataSource.

func (f DataSourceFunc) Collect(ctx context.Context, at time.Time) (Snapshot, error)
    Collect implements DataSource.

type Options struct {
	Source          DataSource
	CollectInterval time.Duration
	RedrawInterval  time.Duration
	View            string
}
    Options configures collection and redraw cadence for a hosted widget.

type Quota struct {
	Name    string
	Used    float64
	ResetIn string
}
    Quota is a fake usage window used by this example's All Usage panel.

type Snapshot struct {
	CapturedAt  time.Time
	Quotas      []Quota
	CPUPercent  float64
	CPUOK       bool
	CPUHistory  []float64
	NumCPU      int
	Load1       float64
	MemoryUsed  float64 // GiB
	MemoryTotal float64 // GiB
	MemoryOK    bool
	Err         string
}
    Snapshot is the immutable data consumed by both example views.
